data.name: Narendr
data.gender_notes: Narendr is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Narendr is derived from the Sanskrit language. It is a compound name formed by combining the words 'Nara' (man) and 'Indra' (god of rain, thunderbolt, and sky). This name signifies one who is the charioteer of Lord Indra, the deity who rides the chariot drawn by horses, elephants, and Gandharvas. In Hindu mythology, Indra is considered as the god of rain and thunder, and Narendr's name signifies being a devoted servant or follower of Lord Indra.
data.etymology: Narendr belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord's Charioteer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Narendr total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
